dataset_and_data_provenance.data_integrity_gate_note: raw/v4_dataset_lock_check.log reports two distinct checks for each of the 4 market-data files: DATA_INTEGRITY_GATE=FAIL (raw byte-level file hash differs from the lock, attributed in the log's own text to serialization-only differences, e.g. feather format version) and DATASET_LOCK_GATE=PASS (canonical, format-invariant content hash matches the frozen lock exactly). The FAIL label is the raw-hash sub-check, not the run's overall data verdict; the canonical-content verdict, which is what the lock file is designed to guarantee, is PASS. Recorded here verbatim rather than summarized as a single PASS/FAIL to avoid manufacturing certainty the source log does not state as one line.
